author: Mathematical
body:
Most of you guys probably know that the Elimination gamemode has not been played very much. So I thought of an idea to improve it! I think there should be a random thingy before an Elimination game starts to make each Elimination game different.
There should be a system where teams can be chosen, the server will randomly pick either type A, type B, type C, or type D (Each type has a 25% chance of being picked). Type A is to just simply make the game free for all. Type B is to divide the game into teams by setting the amount of teams in the game (There can be either 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 teams in the game). Type C is to divide the game into teams by setting the amount of players per team (There can be either 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 players per team). Type D is to divide the game into teams by request by 4 randomly selected players who place bets for picking their players (Just like the loved slave market way :P).
There should also be a system on how the game will be rushed, the server will randomly pick either type A, type B, type C, or type D (Each type has a 25% chance of being picked). Type A is to give each player at the beginning of the game a compass that leads to the closest enemy. Type B is to have a time limit (It an be 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 minutes max) and let the winning team be the one with the most kills. Type C is to teleport all living players to a deathmatch arena after 15 minutes (Players are warned at 14 min in game). Type D is to have the world border slowly shrink until it has a diameter of 15 blocks.
Finally, I would love 3 twist to be randomly chosen for the game. The twist could be things like kits being disabled, no natural regeneration (UHC :D), a wither spawned when grace period ends, monsters being naturally spawned at night, nether being enabled, forever night, blindness effect all game (Scary D:), friendly fire on for teams (Might not go so well...), lava replacing water, rain of flaming arrows every minute, and much more twist that shall be suggested by the community and developers! :)
